title: Email marketing sequences
body: Turn new subscribers into customers with emails that send themselves at the right moment, from a warm welcome to timely follow-ups. You stay in touch with every lead without writing the same email twice.

title: CRM lead capture and follow-up
body: Every enquiry from your website, forms and socials lands in one place and gets a fast, personal follow-up automatically. No lead slips through the cracks, and you always know who to call next.

title: Social media scheduling
body: Plan a month of posts in one sitting and let them go out at the best times across all your channels. Your business stays visible every day while you get on with running it.

title: Automated invoicing and payments
body: Invoices go out the moment a job is done, reminders chase late payers politely, and payments are matched for you. Get paid faster with far less admin.

title: Appointment booking
body: Let customers book, reschedule and cancel online 24/7, with automatic confirmations and reminders. Fewer phone calls, fewer no-shows and a fuller diary.

title: Customer support chat
body: Answer common questions instantly, day or night, and hand anything complex straight to you with the full conversation attached. Customers get quick help and you get your time back.

title: Review collection
body: Automatically ask happy customers for a review at just the right time, with a one-tap link. Build a steady stream of fresh reviews that win you more business.

title: Inventory alerts
body: Get a heads-up before your best sellers run out, so you can reorder in time. Avoid lost sales and stop over-ordering stock that just sits on the shelf.

title: Order and shipping notifications
body: Keep customers updated from order to doorstep with automatic confirmations, dispatch notices and tracking links. Fewer "where's my order?" messages and happier repeat buyers.

title: Analytics reporting
body: Your key numbers, from sales to leads to marketing results, delivered in one clear report on a schedule that suits you. Make decisions based on facts without digging through spreadsheets.
